a: अशिशु — a. Childless, without young ones. --शुः A youth. --श्वी, अशिश्विका 1 A childless female; without young ones (as a cow). --2 A childless woman.

अ-शिव n. ill-luck, RV. i, 116, 24; x, 23, 5; MBh. &c.
a: अशिव — a. 1 Inauspicious, causing or threatening mischief; अशिवा दिशि दीप्तायां शिवास्तत्र भयावहाः (रुरुवुः) Rām. --2 Unlucky, unfortunate. --3 Unkind, unfriendly, envious. --4 Pernicious, dangerous. --वः N. of a certain divine being. --वा A female demon or goblin. --वं 1 Ill-luck, misfortune. --2 Mischief. --Comp. --आचारः {1} improper behaviour, rudeness of conduct. {2} conduct opposed to every (sacred) authority.

अशिष्ठ See √ 2. अश्.
a: अशिष्ठ — a. 1 Eating much. --2 Ved. Reaching very far. --ष्ठः Fire.

v: aSizwa

tri॰ na॰ ta॰ । 1 upadizwaBinne yaska SAsanaM na kftaM tasmin । SizwaH sADuH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । 2 asADO sADutvaYca vedArTe viSvAsavattvamiti dinakarI 3 tadBinne nAstike 4 parRasaNkarakArake vyaBicAravaMtica “aSizwavyavahAre dARaH prayoge caturTyarTe tftIyA” vArtti॰ ।

a: अशिष्ट — a. 1 Ill-bred, ill-behaved, rude. --2 Unrefined, barbarous, not respectable, unworthy; ˚आलापेन Pt. 4. --3 Atheistical, profane. --4 Not sanctioned by any recognized authority. --5 Not prescribed in any work of authority; ˚ता, ˚त्त्वं rudeness.

m: अ-शिष्ट—ता, f. or अ-शिष्ट—त्व, n. rudeness

(a thing) that need not be taught or which it is unnecessary to teach, Pāṇ. i, 2, 53.
a: अशिष्य — a. Not to be taught, not to be informed.

m: अशिष्य-वृत्ति mfn. not behaving like a pupil, MBh.
